choice.basis: The pie chart titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' lists four categories with their consumption shares: Nuclear (40%), Hydroelectric (25%), Renewables (20%), and Fossil Fuels (15%). The routing criterion is to identify the largest global energy consumption category and route it to priority source monitoring. Nuclear has the highest percentage (40%), making it the largest category. The option 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring' is available and matches the required action.
choice.option_label: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring
